mapper.select: SELECT status FROM practice_sessions WHERE id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND record_deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: ps.id AS session_id, ps.song_id, s.title AS song_title, s.note_count, ps.score_version, ps.start_note_idx, ps.end_note_idx, ps.bpm, ps.bpm_unit, ps.status, ps.started_at, ps.recording_duration_ms, e.total_score, ps.saved_at, ps.memo, (ps.recording_url IS NOT NULL) AS recording_available, ps.viewed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM practice_sessions ps JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.id = #{sessionId} AND ps.user_id = #{userId} AND ps.record_deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT ps.song_id, s.title, COUNT(*) AS record_count, MAX(ps.saved_at) AS last_saved_at, MAX(e.total_score) AS best_score FROM practice_sessions ps JOIN songs s ON s.id = ps.song_id JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.user_id = #{userId} AND ps.saved_at IS NOT NULL AND ps.record_deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY ps.song_id, s.title ORDER BY last_saved_at DESC, ps.song_id DESC
